BREAKING: only the SECOND RuPaul's Drag Race queen to ever touch down in the Tri-Cities is haunting Azucar's Main Floor. 😱💀 Arietty — Season 17 — is coming for Pasco, and this is not a drill. Rohla Blunt hosts, Miss Jaxon and Victoria Amore bring the screams, and the whole night is built to send chills down your spine (the good kind). History is happening at Out & About and you do NOT want to be the one who missed it. Tickets are moving — grab yours before this one's a sold-out ghost story you weren't part of. 🩸👑

📅 Friday, October 23 — Doors 8PM, Show 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $25-$55
🔞 21+

Fog rolls across the Main Floor. Glitter catches the black-light like blood under strobes. 🖤🩸 This is Scream Queens — where horror-glam meets full drag spectacle and every number hits like a jump scare you can feel in your chest. Arietty from RuPaul's Drag Race Season 17 stalks the stage, Rohla Blunt keeps the chaos moving as host, and Miss Jaxon and Victoria Amore deliver the screams live. Smoke, sequins, sharp heels on hardwood — it's theater, it's terror, it's a party all at once. You're not watching a show, you're inside one. 💅🕸️

Come as you are, come in costume, come screaming — Azucar's Main Floor is opening its doors for a night built for this community. 🖤👻 Scream Queens brings Arietty (RuPaul's Drag Race Season 17) to Pasco, backed by Rohla Blunt hosting and Miss Jaxon and Victoria Amore serving looks and terror in equal measure. This is Latinx nightlife at its loudest and most fabulous — a room full of people who get it, dressed up, tipping the queens, screaming together. No matter who you are, there's a seat with your name on it. Bring your people, wear your best fright-night fit, and let the Main Floor hold you all night long. ✨🩸

Here's everything you need to know: Scream Queens Drag Show hits Azucar's Main Floor with Arietty from RuPaul's Drag Race Season 17 — the second Drag Race queen ever booked in the Tri-Cities. 📋💀 Rohla Blunt hosts. Miss Jaxon and Victoria Amore round out the lineup. Doors open at 8PM, show starts at 9PM, and tickets run $25-$55 depending on where you want to sit for the scares. This is 21+, so leave the kiddos home and bring your ID. Get there early, get your seat, and get ready for a night of horror-glam drag that's already the talk of the town. 🎃🖤
